title: OneRetrieval: Unifying Multi-Branch E-commerce Retrieval with an Editable Generative Model
title_zh: OneRetrieval：用可编辑生成式模型统一多分支电商召回
abstract_en: Industrial e-commerce search serves hundreds of millions of items through a multi-branch retrieval stage fused by hand-tuned merging without joint optimization. Generative retrieval (GR) raises the prospect of collapsing this stage into a single model, yet unification is gated by more than retrieval quality: the inverted-index branch converts below the platform average yet persists because it is almost the only branch where operations can inject a new term within hours without any model update; a one-model substitute must preserve this real-time editability. Existing GR methods structurally lack it: closed-codebook methods fix each slot to a quantized embedding at training, while open-vocabulary methods leave new-term routing to model generalization. We present OneRetrieval, a one-model GR framework built on Keyword-Aligned Encoding (KAE), which ties each identifier position to an interpretable attribute word, pairing competitive recall quality with the editability of the inverted index -- to our knowledge the first editable generative retrieval method. An information-theoretic merging organizes 18 attribute categories into six codebook groups with non-uniform capacity; reserved slots in each codebook can be bound to new words after deployment without retraining; and a four-stage fine-tuning pipeline secures quality and editability jointly. On five million real-traffic requests, OneRetrieval matches the deep recall of the strongest generative baseline, with an intervention hit rate over an order of magnitude above closed-codebook encodings. Online, replacing the inverted-index branch significantly lifts order volume; extending to nearly the entire stage holds conversion while improving CTR. The system is deployed at Kuaishou, serving hundreds of millions of PVs daily.
abstract_zh: 工业电商搜索通常依赖多分支召回，并通过人工调参的融合策略服务海量商品，但缺乏端到端联合优化。Generative Retrieval（GR）有望用单一模型替代这一阶段，不过真正落地不仅要求召回质量，还必须保留倒排索引分支的实时可编辑性：运营可在数小时内注入新词而无需更新模型。现有 GR 方法难以满足这一点，闭合码本方法在训练时固定每个槽位的量化嵌入，开放词表方法则依赖模型对新词的泛化。本文提出 OneRetrieval，一个基于 Keyword-Aligned Encoding（KAE）的单模型 GR 框架，将标识符的每个位置与可解释属性词绑定，在保持竞争性召回质量的同时具备类似倒排索引的可编辑能力。方法通过信息论合并将 18 类属性组织为 6 个非均匀容量的 codebook group，并在每个 codebook 中预留槽位，使新词可在部署后绑定而无需重训；同时设计四阶段微调流程联合保障召回质量与可编辑性。在 500 万真实流量请求上，OneRetrieval 达到最强生成式基线的深度召回效果，干预命中率比闭合码本编码高一个数量级以上。线上实验中，替换倒排索引分支显著提升订单量；进一步扩展到几乎整个召回阶段时，在保持转化率的同时提升 CTR。该系统已部署于 Kuaishou，每日服务数亿 PV。
key_points_zh: 提出 OneRetrieval，用单一 Generative Retrieval 模型统一工业电商多分支召回，目标是在保持召回质量的同时减少人工融合与分支维护成本。
核心是 Keyword-Aligned Encoding（KAE）：将生成式标识符位置与可解释属性词对齐，使模型具备类似倒排索引的运营可编辑性。
通过信息论合并将 18 个属性类别组织为 6 个非均匀容量的 codebook group，并预留可绑定新词的槽位，实现部署后无需重训的实时词项注入。
设计四阶段 fine-tuning pipeline，同时优化深度召回质量与新词干预命中能力，弥补现有 closed-codebook 与 open-vocabulary GR 的不足。
在 Kuaishou 真实大规模流量中验证：离线匹配最强生成式基线，线上替换倒排索引分支显著提升订单量，扩展到近全召回阶段后保持 CVR 并提升 CTR。

llm_assessment.comment: A major industrial e-commerce retrieval contribution that unifies multi-branch retrieval with editable generative retrieval and demonstrates large-scale online gains.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项重要的工业级电商检索贡献，用可编辑生成式检索统一多路召回并展示了大规模线上收益。
